verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback are fair questions for a browser-automation framework, but the evidence pack documents no first-party automation versioning, change review, or rollback. The nearest items are server-side caching, selfHeal re-inference, converting agent runs into deterministic scripts, and Browserbase session replay. These are adjacent features, and keeping scripts in the user's own git repo would be a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.
